title: Causal Attention Mask with Offset
signature: def causal_mask(T_q: int, T_k: int, offset: int = 0) -> np.ndarray
hints: Query row i sits at absolute position i + offset. Key column j sits at position j.
A query may see a key when j <= i + offset. That includes itself.
Build row and column index grids with np.arange and broadcasting, then np.where(allowed, 0.0, -np.inf).
